digest.component_or_area: plan-review pass-1 and batch runner usage aggregation
propositions: Pass-1 findings functions (pass1_chunk, pass1_container, pass1_isf) discard per-call LLM usage returned by runner.run, preventing token totals and per-criterion request counts from reaching BatchRunResult outputs and sidecar
Per-criterion request counts are extracted by runner._extract_usage but never persisted, blocking data-driven criterion demotion decisions

Usage must be threaded as (findings, usage_dict) pairs through the call chain from runner through sizing.pass1_with_ladder, pass1 container fan-out, ISF path, and prerequisite.run_focused_finder with all external callers updated atomically

Multi-criterion chunks must divide token fields equally across covered criteria while counting llm_calls and requests in full per criterion; ladder retries each append a call record with identical criteria list
